Finally, Bengaluru – Mangaluru – Goa has a new Vande Bharat connection! 🚆

Covering around 670 km with 12 stops along the way, this new service connects some of Karnataka’s most important coastal destinations, including Mangaluru, Udupi, Kundapura, Murdeshwar and Gokarna.

What makes this particularly useful is the connectivity it brings to Mangaluru, whether you’re travelling for college, work or visiting family, and for people heading towards popular pilgrimage destinations like Kukke Subrahmanya, Udupi and Kollur Mookambika.

The train comes with modern interiors, comfortable reclining seats, onboard catering and even 180-degree rotating seats to enjoy the Western Ghats views.

It takes approximately 13 hours and 20 minutes from Bengaluru to Madgaon, departing Yesvantpur at 7:35 AM.

Regular services start November 15, except Wednesdays.

Definitely one to save for your next coastal Karnataka or Goa trip!
